'''''Black Ice''''' was the centrepiece of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209/Legends|Replenishment Fleet DK-209]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:BlackIceScale.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Black Ice'' size comparison chart]]
''Black Ice'' was an enormous [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessel]], a cargo vessel roughly stretching the length of five [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]], that consisted of nine vast force-field spheres connected in a single line between its bow and stern tugs. The vessel could haul just shy of one billion metric tons of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] fuel cells, over a year's worth of fuel for a full Imperial battle fleet.

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], ''Black Ice'' was [[Battle for Black Ice|captured]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at [[Refrax]] within [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]], but she was later [[Blitz on Fangol|destroyed]] when she was rammed into an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Fangol)|Torpedo Sphere]] at [[Fangol]].<ref name="BI" />
